previous_statement: Nondegenerate local fixed-point index: if x is an isolated fixed point of a C^1 self-map f with det(I-Df_x) != 0, then its local fixed-point index is sgn det(I-Df_x).
new_statement: Nondegenerate local fixed-point index: if x is an isolated fixed point of a smooth self-map f of a compact orientable manifold with det(I-Df_x) != 0, then its local fixed-point index is sgn det(I-Df_x).
